brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 full hex bases placed contiguously at q=0-3, r=0, level 0 (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full, piece:3,0,0;full). Provides four-cell structure; planter bins not yet fitted.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: No run present (counts: piece 4, run 0). Attempts to addRun through all four cells returned ROUTE_NO_PATH for every through combination; simple single-entry runs succeeded in tests but full-through route covering all cells was not achieved and was removed before finish. meshClash is clear but no irrigation route exists.

finish.summary: Four contiguous bases achieved. Pipe run to feed every cell not completed - routing failed and build ends with no run. Bins/planters also not installed.
